title: Text specialization
description:
There are 4 main text specialization elements in HTML: `b`, `i`, `u`, and `s`. `b` makes text bold, `i` makes text italic, `u` underlines text, and `s` makes text strikethrough.

---
## Assignment:
Make the error code's 500 bold, underline the error description (not the :), and make the Please try again later italic.
starterHtml:
500: Internal Server Error

The server was unable to complete your request. Please try again later.

reqElems.value: The server was unable to complete your request.
